topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: The ground beneath my paws feels different today, soft where it once was firm. My nose traces the air, catching scents that shouldn't mix—earth disturbed and something metallic, old yet not forgotten. I move closer, the silence heavy around me, and see the earth gouged, a place where it doesn’t belong. Something lies half-buried, its surface cold and unyielding, different from the warm, living things I know. It holds stories, I can sense it, but not ones I understand. I circle it, my heart thudding, the forest watching with me. I want to run, but my feet stay rooted, curiosity sharp as any claw.
